text: Good morning, everyone! I'm Ada, and I keep bees, so my morning errand started at the hives, checking that the colony was warm and humming. Then I wandered the hamlet to the orchard, where the blossoms are drawing in my bees, and I had a lovely walk toward the cottage knoll. Now I'm here at the pond hall, happy to hear how your mornings went.
speaker: ada

text: Um, hi. My morning changed plans a few times. I was sent to the pond hall, then the orchard, then told to stop, and finally back here. I'm shy, so I took it as a quiet tune: keep moving, keep humming. I'm glad I ended up here with you.
